recipe.visualDefinition: A structured 1960s album cover featuring a large green field with a central white-bordered frame containing stacked, high-impact block typography and a low-key photograph of a musician with their instrument.
coreVisualRelationships: Stacked hierarchy of text blocks within a thin white border
High-contrast color blocking between forest green, vibrant orange, and yellow
Juxtaposition of massive sans-serif type against a dark, moody photographic subject
Asymmetrical balance between the image on the left and a tracklist on the right
coreInvariants: Thin white rectangular frame with rounded bottom corners
Low-key lighting in the photographic inset

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject occupies the bottom-left quadrant of the central frame, scaled to roughly 40% of the frame's height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive orange title block at the top of the frame acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical descent from the title to the artist name, then splitting between the image and the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample green margins surrounding the central white-bordered container create a sense of focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Forest green background provides a stable, saturated base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow for the primary text blocks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the border, secondary text, and metadata.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text blocks contrasts with the low-value, dark photographic area.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 4-5 colors: Green, Orange, Yellow, White, and Black.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with minimal contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is a decorative, script-like flourish that breaks the rigid geometry of the block type.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family, paired with a singular decorative ampersand.
graphicDevices: Thin white border with rounded bottom corners

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the primary title.
Provides the necessary weight and mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid forest green background. In the center, place a large rectangular frame with a thin white stroke. The bottom two corners of the frame should be rounded. In the bottom-left of this frame, place a low-key photograph of a person playing a steel guitar against a dark background. Leave the right side of the bottom section empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-bold condensed sans-serif text in orange at the top of the frame. Below it, add similar text in yellow. Use a white decorative ampersand. On the bottom right, list items in a smaller white sans-serif font, aligned left.

verificationChecks: Is the green background a deep forest hue?
Are the bottom corners of the white frame rounded?
Is the orange text the largest element?
Is the ampersand the only non-geometric typographic element?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the white frame
Ratio of image to tracklist area
Specific colors of the text blocks
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered within the frame width.
Check that the white border is consistent in thickness.
Verify the photograph is dark and moody to contrast with the bright text.
Confirm the ampersand is stylized and decorative.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid saturated background + Thin white frame with rounded bottom corners + Stacked ultra-bold condensed sans-serif blocks + Low-key photographic inset.
